'''Richard Handley''' wrote for ''Star Wars Insider''. At [[DecipherCon 1999]] [[Evan Lorentz]] and Super Vol [[Kim Burns]] briefed him on the Star Trek CCG World Finals.<ref name="fri26">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000612184011/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri26.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri26], Decipher (Wayback 12 June 2000). Caption: "Evan Lorentz and Super Vol Kim Burns tell Star Wars Insider writer Richard Handley what's happening with the Star Trek CCG World Finals"</ref>
